title: mspp_webform
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): mspp_createdby, mspp_modifiedby, mspp_startstep, mspp_websiteid.

mspp_authenticationrequired.description: Redirect to sign in if the user is anonymous.

mspp_createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

mspp_editexistingrecordpermitted.description: Determines if an existing record can be edited.

mspp_editexpiredstatecode.description: Display name: Edit Expired State Code

mspp_editexpiredstatuscode.description: Display name: Edit Expired Status Code

mspp_editnotpermittedmessage.description: Display name: Edit Not Permitted Message

mspp_modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was modified.

mspp_multiplerecordsperuserpermitted.description: Display name: Multiple Records Per User Permitted

mspp_name.description: The name of the custom entity.

mspp_progressindicatorignorelaststep.description: Display name: Ignore Last Step In Progress Count

mspp_progressindicatorposition.description: Location of the progress indicator relative to the form

mspp_progressindicatorprependstepnum.description: Display name: Prepend Step Number to Step Title

mspp_savechangeswarningmessage.description: Default message: Your changes have not been saved.

mspp_savechangeswarningonclose.description: Displays a warning message to the user if they close the browser, or refresh the page, or click the previous button in a multiple step form…

mspp_startnewsessiononload.description: Display name: Start New Session On Load

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Multistep Form

_mspp_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_mspp_startstep_value.description: Unique identifier for Form Step associated with Multistep Form.

_mspp_websiteid_value.description: Unique identifier for Website entity associated with this record
